Human-written mechanism-of-action / PD biomarker cascade reference document.

extraction_summary.notes: Initial extraction phase: contexts, conditions, assays registered. Observations (digitized data) not yet implemented.

resistance_selectivity.description: Tier-4 IC50 shift ONLY occurs in docetaxel-resistant sublines (PC3-Rx, DU145-Rx), NOT in parental lines (PC3, DU145). This is a crucial effect modifier and should not be treated as a population constant.

fak_akt_model_system_dependence.description: Tier-2 FAK-AKT coupling is model-system-dependent: clean in PC3 (in vitro) and PC3 xenograft, completely absent in patient explants (p=0.71/0.27/0.22 for DTX/VS6/combo vs control). Model structure, not just parameters, may need to differ by data source.

tumor_volume_biphasic_response.description: Tier-4 in vivo tumor volume (Fig 4A) shows biphasic response in combination arm: transient regression to ~85% by day 19-21, then slow regrowth. Simple monotonic Emax TGI model insufficient; requires regrowth/relapse or effective-exposure-decay term.

normalization_differences.description: PC3 panels (Figs 2B-C) normalize P-FAK to T-FAK; DU145 panels (Figs 3B-C) normalize to β-actin (DU145-Rx batch had elevated total FAK). Do NOT compare absolute ratios across these figures.

four_term_equation_validation.description: This single paper validates all four terms of eq:pd_target_suppression_chemo_sensitization_tte in PC3/PC3-Rx system
